basics.name: Filipe Barros
basics.label: Software Engineer · Tech Lead
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer and tech lead with over a decade of experience across fintech, e-learning and digital media. Equally comfortable on frontend and backend, working across TypeScript, Scala, Ruby and Elixir. Proven record of leading high-impact, data-driven projects, integrating machine learning to sharpen personalisation, and mentoring fellow engineers. Motivated by elegant solutions and by leaving every codebase better than I found it.

work.summary: Personal-finance platform that helps members understand and improve their credit score, and surfaces personalised financial offers.
highlights: Currently leading the UK team on the frontend implementation of Credit Karma Plus, a new (US-only) subscription product, while also working on the backend, implementing the GraphQL API and Thrift service definitions, plus the TypeScript that returns the data, backed by Cloud Spanner on Google Cloud Platform.

Led the design and delivery of the International team's (UK & Canada) most impactful project in two years: a personalised-content feature that uses members' credit-report data and behavioural signals to determine content eligibility.
Integrated machine-learning recommendation models into the feature to improve content relevance against key business metrics, then led its successful rollout to the Canadian market.
Worked full-stack across internal services in TypeScript and Scala, contributing to both frontend and backend.
Supported colleagues' initiatives both as a hands-on contributor and by mentoring them in project leadership.

work.summary: Learning platform that helps companies deliver targeted training to their employees.
highlights: Led two teams (events and the core learning platform), designing features that let clients integrate their learning status with third-party systems.
Built event-driven integrations using AWS SNS, SQS and Lambda, with automated deployments via GitHub Actions.
Reworked the release process, cutting manual effort by automating release creation and streamlining deployments.

work.summary: Peer-to-peer lending platform connecting small and medium businesses with investors.
highlights: Built and maintained internal business systems that streamlined day-to-day processes for other teams.
Developed new microservices and improved existing ones to support evolving business needs.

work.summary: Business-media company specialising in summit organisation and digital media services.
highlights: Developed new features and products while supporting the company's full suite of applications.
Worked with Ruby on Rails and MySQL deployed on AWS, adopting React on the frontend.

work.summary: Developer of casino games for its own brands and white-label partners.
highlights: Contributed to technical decision-making within the engineering team.
Built features using Java, Spring, Hibernate, MySQL, Couchbase and AngularJS.

projects.name: Dotfiler
projects.description: A safe, powerful dotfiles manager written in Elixir. Symlinks your dotfiles with automatic backups, dry-run preview, full restore, gitignore-style filtering and optional Homebrew integration — backed by 120+ tests, Dialyzer type checking and CI.

projects.name: Project Indicator
projects.description: A blazingly fast Rust CLI that detects a project's language and framework — 23+ languages and 37+ frameworks — for shell-prompt integration. Ships with persistent caching, TOML configuration, and Bash/Zsh/Fish integration scripts, with typical detection in 3-5ms.

projects.name: alfredfm
projects.description: A Last.fm workflow for Alfred on macOS, written in Ruby — control playback, love tracks and look up music without leaving the Alfred bar. My most-starred open-source project (16★).
